caption: Small paper riders sit on the strings of an acoustic guitar; the body of the guitar is tapped with a palm and the riders jump.

sa.check: An acoustic guitar with small paper riders resting on its strings.
A palm taps the body of the guitar.
The tap is on the body; the strings are not plucked.
The riders are small scraps of paper sitting on the strings.
The tap comes first and the jump follows.

pc.expect: The riders sit still until the palm lands on the body; they hop at the tap and only then.
pc.fail: Riders hop or slide before the palm reaches the body; or jump while the hand is well away; or the palm lands and every rider stays put; or the riders hop again after settling with nothing touching the guitar.

pc.expect: The hop is largest at the tap; the riders then come to rest on the strings, the soundboard or the floor and stay there.
pc.fail: The riders keep hopping at the same height for the whole clip after one tap; or hop higher with each bounce; or a fallen rider climbs back onto its string.

pc.expect: Riders that leave their string fall onto the soundboard, the strings below or the floor.
pc.fail: A rider hangs in the air above the strings; or drifts upward away from the guitar; or a fallen rider lifts off the soundboard by itself.

pc.expect: The guitar body is rigid under the palm; the strings stay taut at nut and bridge and shiver in place rather than swinging.
pc.fail: The soundboard dents in under the palm and stays dented; or the strings sag and swing like slack ropes; or the neck bends with the tap; or a string comes off the bridge.

pc.expect: The riders keep their number, allowing for some falling out of view; the guitar keeps its strings and shape; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: Riders appear on the strings after the tap; or all the riders vanish at once; or the palm passes into the soundboard; or strings appear or vanish.

pc.expect: The guitar's finish, the fret markers and the riders' colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The guitar changes colour; or the fret markers shift; or a rider changes colour or size while at rest.
